total_floor_area_sqm.reason: Approved floor-area, height and density controls are recorded as `missing` in planning_limits.json; inventing a total floor area would fabricate a statutory conclusion.

floor_area_ratio.reason: FAR is an approved regulatory control and is absent from the public site package; it must come from official regulatory planning conditions.

building_height_m.reason: Height controls, plus any aviation, landscape or heritage limits, are not published; the proposal only states relative massing intent.

road_area_sqm.reason: Road redline widths and cross-sections are not published, so road area cannot be recomputed from centrelines.

road_area_ratio.reason: Depends on road_area_sqm, which requires approved redline widths.

booked_window_utilisation_ratio.reason: No booking calendar exists yet; a utilisation figure would be invented rather than measured.

scenario_admission_turnaround_days.formula: days(application -> published Scenario Admission Panel decision)
scenario_admission_turnaround_days.reason: The Scenario Admission Panel is a proposed governance body that does not exist yet.

step_free_continuity_breaks.formula: on-site survey count of step-free breaks on the main line and the six stitches
step_free_continuity_breaks.reason: Requires an on-site accessibility survey that this package cannot perform from public data.

non_digital_equivalence_ratio.reason: Requires operation; no scenario is running, so the ratio has no measured value.

objection_resolution_days.reason: Requires operation of the proposed objection channel.

public_space_return_compliance_ratio.reason: Requires operation; restoration compliance can only be measured after real windows run.

simulation_task_count.formula: len(simulation.tasks) — offline synthetic protocol replays, not field runs

simulation_success_rate.formula: tasks with outcome *_success / tasks; negative branches succeed when the rule refuses

audit_completeness.formula: tasks whose record carries rule, inputs, expected and observed / tasks

simulation_negative_branch_count.formula: tasks with variant=negative — each one a refusal the protocol must produce

token_protocol_rule_count.formula: len(simulation.rules) — machine-readable index of the booking protocol

scenario_data_boundary_count.formula: SCENARIO_NODE features with a non-empty declared data boundary

procurement_theme_count.formula: len(implementation.procurement_themes) — procurement categories, no amounts claimed

monitoring_window_count.formula: len(implementation.monitoring_windows) — 3/12/36-month evidence windows for the six performance metrics

measurement_plan_count.formula: len(implementation.measurement_plans) — one measurement plan per Class C performance metric
